title: Tune blockDim + shared budget for max occupancy (CUDA)
info: Real CUDA-C compiled by arena.cuda_c.CudaProgram, executed on arena.cuda_sim.GPU.
6 candidate blockDims (32..1024); fixed regs_per_thread=32, shared_bytes_per_thread=64, and SM limits (2048 threads / 32 blocks / 65536 regs / 98304 shared bytes).

The reference maximum achievable occupancy on this fixture is 0.75, reached at several blockDims (64, 128, 256, 512) -- the gate only checks that SOME candidate's computed occupancy reaches that same maximum, not which one.
